description: Use this when an agent needs official daily FX reference rates (ECB, Bank of Canada) with Data BitScore. kind="intuitive" (default): one pair (default EURUSD); kind="stats": FX table + conversion; kind="pro": history; kind="signals": notable moves + policy rates. Reference rates, not tradable quotes. Returns JSON `data` with attribution. Kinds: intuitive (5 sats or $0.003 USDC), stats (17 sats or $0.01 USDC), pro (33 sats or $0.02 USDC), signals (33 sats or $0.02 USDC). Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 Base USDC payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']).
